box: daily-fortune (/game/daily-fortune/) — renderAsk -> enter name -> submit -> reveal -> renderResult, walked end to end in a real browser (mount() had never executed in any engine before this run)
method:
scripts/driver.mjs, one CDP tab, real headless Chrome (--headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --remote-debugging-port=9222), against a real build (npm run build + npx serve dist/ -l 4321). Navigated to http://localhost:4321/game/daily-fortune/, wiped storage on-origin (never about:blank) and verified localStorage.length === 0 / sessionStorage.length === 0 after the wipe. Mounted the game through the real UI: set #player-count to 2 (this game's own min), clicked #start-numbered (dispatches watduang:start with ['คนที่ 1','คนที่ 2'], which src/pages/game/[id].astro's listener turns into game.mount(stage, ctx)). Calibrated the result-screen detector BEFORE submitting (trap 2 in docs/agents/browser-verification.md: 'stage has non-empty text' is true on the ask screen too, so it proves nothing) -- read #df-again/#df-name presence on the ask screen and asserted the discriminating pair is false/true respectively, THEN typed the real Thai name 'ก้อง' into #df-name (dispatching a real 'input' event) and clicked #df-go (the actual submit path, not a synthetic form.submit()), then re-read the same pair after.
